problems.statement: Characterize the nonnegative integers representable as a^3+b^3+c^3-3abc for nonnegative integers a,b,c, proving that N is representable exactly when 3 does not divide N or 9 divides N.
problems.source_private: reference/cubic-form-image-reference.md (2019 Putnam A1, official MAA problem and solution)
problems.structural_rationale: Two independent directions: explicit residue-class constructions and a divisibility-strengthening lemma from 3 to 9.

problems.statement: For prime p>5, count nonzero-mod-p infinite sequences satisfying a_n a_(n+2)=1+a_(n+1), and prove that the count is congruent to 0 or 2 modulo 5.
problems.source_private: reference/period-five-recurrence-reference.md (2022 Putnam A3, official MAA problem and solution)
problems.structural_rationale: A period-five recurrence lemma reduces an infinite object to cyclic orbits, followed by a fixed-point quadratic count.

problems.statement: For every nonnegative integer k, prove the weighted binomial identity sum from j=0 to k of 2^(k-j) binom(k+j,j) equals 4^k.
problems.source_private: reference/weighted-binomial-paths-reference.md (2020 Putnam A2, official MAA problem and solution)
problems.structural_rationale: A first-hit lattice-path decomposition supplies the meaningful intermediate counting lemma and a second global count closes the proof.

problems.statement: For an orthogonal Q without a nonzero fixed vector and the reflection H=I-2uu^T for unit u, prove that HQ has a nonzero fixed vector.
problems.source_private: reference/reflection-fixed-vector-reference.md (2019 Putnam B3, official MAA problem and solution)
problems.structural_rationale: A reusable eigenvalue-parity lemma connects the local determinant calculation for a rank-one reflection to the target fixed vector.
